highlight.$description: Light gold behind what needs the owner: the Ekklo food to choose (04d) and values that moved in MyFitnessPal (06e).

scrim.$description: Modal scrim under sheets, at 50% opacity.

dark.$description: Cream, the inverted surface in dark: snack bars, hints and tooltips, dark pills, the chosen serving.

glass.$description: #2B2925 at 45% over the refracted backdrop: the tint of clear glass, on the tab plate, the Scanner button, clear glass buttons, search fields and filters.

glass-ink.$description: Cream at 90% over the refracted backdrop: the primary button and the chosen filter.

lens-reflection.$description: Reflection along the top and bottom edges inside the glass lens over a held switch, fading towards the middle.

glass-lens.$description: White at 16%, the tint of the glass lens that swells under the finger on the tab plate.

glass-glow.$description: White at 20%, the light that grows under the finger inside a pressed glass button.

scroll-fade.$description: Washi at 55%, the inner end of the fades over the half days at both ends of the Journal week band. The other end is the same colour at 0%.

pressed.$description: #F7F1E0 at 8%, the light wash under a pressed, hovered or focused surface.

accent.$description: Accent fill: progress, checkbox and switch on, done step, green button, verified dot.

neutral.$description: Neutral fills: neutral chips, switch off, segmented control, clear button, skeletons, offline banner.

floating.$description: Drop shadow of floating glass: the tab plate and the Scanner button.

logo.$description: Drop shadow of the Fūjin logo on the splash screen.

alert.$description: Field in error, danger outline button.

control.$description: Unselected radio, sheet handle, dashed empty ring, offline banner outline.

focus.$description: Focused field, selected radio, selected candidate.

warning.$description: Gold outline of an item to review (Ekklo match to choose).

on-dark.$description: Text and icons on role/background/dark or role/goal/selected-day. Inverted in the dark theme.

on-dark-secondary.$description: Secondary text on role/background/dark: the detail line of a snack bar. Inverted in the dark theme.

glass-link.$description: Text and icons on a validated glass control: text.link in light, lighter in dark, where the glass lifts the tint behind it (ADR 0041).

glass-gold.$description: Text and icons on an attention glass control: deeper than text.gold in light, so it keeps 4.5:1 on the gold tint (ADR 0042); lighter in dark, where the glass lifts the tint behind it (ADR 0041).

glass-info.$description: Text and icons on an info glass control: text.info in light, lighter in dark, where the glass lifts the tint behind it (ADR 0041).

glass-alert.$description: Text and icons on an alert glass control: darker than text.alert in light, so it keeps 4.5:1 on the vermilion tint (ADR 0042); lighter in dark, where the glass lifts the tint behind it (ADR 0041).

glass-secondary.$description: Text and icons on a muted glass control: text.secondary in light, lighter in dark, where the glass lifts the tint behind it (ADR 0041).

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on an accent, source or goal fill.

missed.$description: Arc of a past day that stayed under 98% of its goal. Its length shows the share reached.

missed-background.$description: Background of a past day that stayed under 98% of its goal.

exceeded-logged.$description: Share already logged, goal exceeded (food sheet bars).

in-progress-logged.$description: Share already logged, goal not reached (food sheet bars).

reached-logged.$description: Share already logged, goal reached (food sheet bars).

accent.$description: Viewfinder corners and scan line. Same value in both themes.

background.$description: Camera chrome: round buttons over the camera. Same value in both themes.

button.$description: Button over the camera: washi at 18 % on the camera feed, label role/camera/text. Same value in both themes.

text.$description: Text and icons over the camera. Same value in both themes.

text-secondary.$description: Secondary text over the camera, under the scanner title. Same value in both themes.
